- **TSWV**: Purple-brown spots with bronzing — some similarity but more bronzing, different character
- **CMV**: Shoestring/curled distorted leaves — does not match
- **Septoria**: More defined circular lesions on yellow background — somewhat similar but different scale
- **Verticillium**: V-shaped yellowing, wilting — no match
- **Early Blight**: Large dark lesions with concentric rings — no match
- **Late Blight**: Microscopy image — unusable

The test image shows numerous tiny dark specks with surrounding yellow chlorosis on leaves — most consistent with Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato. The lobed leaf appearance may reflect a cucurbit host in the same Bugwood collection, but the symptom pattern (pinpoint dark specks + yellow halos) matches Bacterial_Speck best among all candidates viewed.
